note: Glue/developer submodule of ebt_core. Provides a DrupalCodeGenerator generator EbtGenerator exposed as the Drush command 'ebt:module' (alias ebt-module, type MODULE_COMPONENT). Running it scaffolds a full EBT block-type module (info.yml, libraries.yml, block_content type + form/view display + body/field_ebt_settings field config, block Twig templates, InstallTest, README, composer.json, CSS). Requires Drush 12+ (hook_requirements). Depends on ebt_core, block_content, media. No config/permissions/plugins of its own beyond the generator. As a glue module: 3 easy / 1 medium / 1 hard. medium introspects that the ebt:module generator is registered with drush on the live site. hard: the agent runs the generator to scaffold a namespaced module (ebt_skprobe) into web/modules/custom/ebt_skprobe (NOT enabled), verified by the generated files on disk. drush generate accepts non-interactive answers via repeated --answer and a --destination path.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal ebt_core_starterkit module, what Drush command does it add, and what does that command do?
evals.expected_output: It adds the Drush generator 'drush generate ebt:module' (alias ebt-module), which scaffolds a new EBT block-type module (info/libraries yml, a block_content type with form/view displays and body + field_ebt_settings fields, Twig templates, an install test, README, composer.json, CSS).

evals.prompt: What does the ebt_core_starterkit generator produce when you run it for a new EBT module?
evals.expected_output: A complete EBT block-type module: {machine_name}.info.yml and .libraries.yml, config/install for a block_content type plus its form/view displays and body + field_ebt_settings field instances, block--block-content--* and block--inline-block--* Twig templates, a functional InstallTest, README, composer.json, and CSS.

evals.prompt: What version of Drush does the Drupal ebt_core_starterkit module require, and why does the machine name of a generated EBT module matter?
evals.expected_output: It requires Drush 12+ (its hook_requirements blocks install on older Drush). The generated module's machine name should use the ebt_ prefix so EBT Core's theme/preprocess plumbing (which keys on the ebt_ bundle prefix) applies to it.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the available Drush generators: what is the name (and/or alias) of the EBT module scaffolding generator provided by ebt_core_starterkit?
evals.expected_output: The generator is named ebt:module (alias ebt-module), listed by 'drush generate' among the available generators (label 'EBT module').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the ebt_core_starterkit generator to scaffold a new EBT block-type module named ebt_skprobe (human name 'EBT SK Probe'), placing the generated files under web/modules/custom/ebt_skprobe. Do NOT enable the module. (Hint: drush generate ebt:module accepts non-interactive answers, e.g. --answer=ebt_skprobe --answer='EBT SK Probe' --destination=web/modules/custom/ebt_skprobe.)
evals.expected_output: The generator wrote web/modules/custom/ebt_skprobe/ebt_skprobe.info.yml and web/modules/custom/ebt_skprobe/config/install/block_content.type.ebt_skprobe.yml (a scaffolded EBT block-type module). The module is left on disk, not enabled.
